F1.evidence: The product ships no hue ramps: core.palette.* is a flat harvest of 21 literal rgb() declarations keyed by value (the warm darks #282425/#333338/#222222, the off-whites, the #458ee1/#3b82f6/#426bd1 blues, #55aa69 green, the rgba pinks and overlay whites), not steps per hue. Honest literals, no ramp organisation exists to tokenise.

F2.evidence: A real surface ladder: bg.z0 -> bg.z1 -> bg.z2 -> bg.z3 (page, rail, panel, raised) plus backdrop.default (the dialog scrim) resolved per theme from --color-bg-z0..z3 and --color-backdrop on :root/.dark:root.

F3.evidence: text.primary, secondary, tertiary, placeholders and invertedPrimary (the on-accent ink) are tokenised from --color-primary/-secondary/-tertiary/-placeholders/-inverted-primary in both themes. No dedicated link or disabled text role exists in the layer - links paint through accent.

F4.evidence: border.default and border.subtle (--color-borders/-borders-subtle) plus focus.ring (--color-focus) resolved per theme; a 'strong' border step does not exist in the layer - strong borders paint through accent (the 2px CTA ring) or literal rgb().

F5.evidence: accent.default/accent.hover, altAccent.default/altAccent.hover and warning.default/warning.hover all resolve per theme. Pressed states are measured per component (nav-cta pressed paints the hover step, recorded as such; app-send-button pressed is a DevTools-forced pseudo-state, never fired).

F6.evidence: Only warning.default + warning.hover (#c7382e/#910a00 light, #ff665b/#ff0000 dark) exist as a status family - used for destructive/leave actions in the app. No success or info role ships; the accent green carries positive actions but is not a success set with fill/text/border variants.

F7.evidence: Full parity: 44 token names resolve identically under html.light and html.dark (44/44), verified by the painted surfaces - dark is the boot theme, light the footer ThemeToggle's repaint. No role exists in one theme alone.

F8.evidence: core.font.family.headline (Pie Headline + fallbacks), body (Pie Body + system stack), mono (Pie Monospace + mono stack) and symbols (Pie Symbols); 10 typography composites (hero 109px/87.2 1.308px tracking, sectionTitle/articleTitle 30/42, body 18/25.2, bodyLink, navLink, button 15/21, urlField, tabLabel, input) with weight/line-height/tracking each.

F10.evidence: Radii are tokenised on components (9999px pills on buttons/inputs/badges, 6px tab cards/send, 10px testimonial card, 0px urlField/themeToggle) and border widths measured per entry (2px CTA rings, 1px hairlines); there is no named core.radius scale.

F11.evidence: Control geometry tokenised: component.nav.height 130px, button.cta.height 51px, tabCard/panelTabs/methodButton/sendButton 28px, urlField/input 44px, appSidebar.width 49px, docsToc.width 314.5px, mobileNav 85px; icon sizes recorded per entry; focus rings measured at 2px solid offset 2px (focus.ring tokenised).

F12.evidence: One shadow role is tokenised per theme (shadow.color from --color-shadows) and component shadows are measured on their entries (the dialog and menu layers in components.md); the product paints essentially one elevation, so a 3-5-level ladder does not exist to grade as meets.

F13.evidence: core.motion holds the measured set: durations 150-4000ms, 9 easing curves, 15 property transitions and 3 named animations (docs fade-in, badge ping, spinner), all from raw/motion.json; the reduced-motion verdict is recorded honestly - the product ignores prefers-reduced-motion.
